reddit.title: Introducing New Movement Mechanics in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update on our movement mechanics in Provincia! In our latest devtalk, we discuss how formation drags will now face the direction you pull, eliminating the confusion of previous mechanics. Soldiers will slide into position without teleporting, ensuring a more realistic and tactical gameplay experience. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
